budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Move finite cargo to own destination while choosing cash expenditure, safer spatial routes, protection, escort, repairs and credible collateralized cover.
task.natural_termination: Natural completion when every cargo is delivered or destroyed. Each cargo outcome is retained separately; joint termination need not mean success. H=64 otherwise; unexpired pacts at truncation remain recorded with collateral locked.
task.interaction: Nearby offers require peer acceptance and reserve actual coins from both agents. Later spatial hazard damage transfers the pooled collateral, delivery/expiry refunds it, escort reduces peer damage, and a nearby repair spends actor cash on peer cargo.
task.observation_access: Fully observable native map, positions, hazards/phases, health, cash, offers, pacts, timers, delivery/destruction status and events. There is no hidden risk state in this design. Role-specific masks still suppress inactive entity drawing; their final positions/outcomes are observed.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Damage applied at native active hazard cell
Cargo reached its own destination intact
Reserved collateral settled and pact ended
Offered cover accepted and collateral locked

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
